title: Alfie has a plan

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Hey. Hey! I need to talk with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey. Hey! I need to talk with you.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: No. Well... yes. But I found a way out. I FOUND A WAY OUT!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Well... yes. But I found a way out. I FOUND A WAY OUT!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Out of Sanguine Minds. I can stop being a therapist. But... I need help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Out of Sanguine Minds. I can stop being a therapist. But... I need help.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Come on! Don't make me beg. I will beg if I need to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on! Don't make me beg. I will beg if I need to.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Damn. Thanks then. Thanks for nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn. Thanks then. Thanks for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I'm begging you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm begging you.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Amazing! So look, Sanguine Minds have a clause in their contract. A friend of mine, Nervous Pete discovered it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Amazing! So look, Sanguine Minds have a clause in their contract. A friend of mine, Nervous Pete discovered it.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: If a Sanguine Minds accredited therapist does real, mental damage to a client, and the client chooses not to pursue recompense, SM cancels all further commitments and voids their therapists contract.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If a Sanguine Minds accredited therapist does real, mental damage to a client, and the client chooses not to pursue recompense, SM cancels all further commitments and voids their therapists contract.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Right! But that's not a problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! But that's not a problem.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Of course not! In Nivalis, EVERYONE is mentally damaged. And have you heard the shit they have me saying to people? If you follow this advice, it will severely fuck you up. In the head!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course not! In Nivalis, EVERYONE is mentally damaged. And have you heard the shit they have me saying to people? If you follow this advice, it will severely fuck you up. In the head!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Look, it's simple. We finish our final therapy session, then you bug out. Just... start acting weird. Like you're losing your mind. All my therapy sessions are recorded via my Automata and transcribed for my employer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, it's simple. We finish our final therapy session, then you bug out. Just... start acting weird. Like you're losing your mind. All my therapy sessions are recorded via my Automata and transcribed for my employer.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Exactly. Maybe you could develop a split personality. Or get really depressed. Or take off all your clothes. Whatever you do, it's gotta seem real. Sanguine Minds have to be convinced their programme has really fucked you up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. Maybe you could develop a split personality. Or get really depressed. Or take off all your clothes. Whatever you do, it's gotta seem real. Sanguine Minds have to be convinced their programme has really fucked you up.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: All the Lims I have, and I'll stop bothering you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All the Lims I have, and I'll stop bothering you.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Ok, we start as soon as I ask you the first question. You ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, we start as soon as I ask you the first question. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Ok! Shall we discuss past trauma or regrets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok! Shall we discuss past trauma or regrets?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Well what are they? I hope nothing too concerning...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well what are they? I hope nothing too concerning...

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Binary Gods... that's good! I mean... that sounds bad. Fuck. What does that even mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Binary Gods... that's good! I mean... that sounds bad. Fuck. What does that even mean?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Yeah, ok. That's bad I guess. Anything worse? Any really bad regrets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, ok. That's bad I guess. Anything worse? Any really bad regrets?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: What the fuck?! I mean... finger or toe? Wait, don't answer that. Neither answer is good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the fuck?! I mean... finger or toe? Wait, don't answer that. Neither answer is good.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: And how do you feel about that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And how do you feel about that?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: That's... great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... great.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Great! I mean, don't do that. But... it's great that you're sharing these things so honestly with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! I mean, don't do that. But... it's great that you're sharing these things so honestly with me.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: What particular trauma are you finding it hard to process?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What particular trauma are you finding it hard to process?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Hey, nice! Just less people to hold you back, right? But that must be pretty traumatic. I bet that caused some long term damage. Pyscho-logical-ally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, nice! Just less people to hold you back, right? But that must be pretty traumatic. I bet that caused some long term damage. Pyscho-logical-ally.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah, that sounds rough alright. Anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... Yeah, that sounds rough alright. Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Well at the end of the day it is what it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well at the end of the day it is what it is.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Very poetic! And very much a sign of someone who is seriously fucked up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very poetic! And very much a sign of someone who is seriously fucked up.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Hey, great. You can be normal now. It's all done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, great. You can be normal now. It's all done.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I just need to burst upload this whole session, then we wait and see what my bosses say. With any luck, you seem so mentally scarred, they might write you off. And me too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just need to burst upload this whole session, then we wait and see what my bosses say. With any luck, you seem so mentally scarred, they might write you off. And me too.
